cli.title: CLI Configuration

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.pruneDesc: Executes `git worktree prune` to remove worktree records that no longer exist.

note.title: Note
note.desc: Settings are saved in `~/.config/wtree/config.json`, UI reads and writes via local API.

helpPage.title: Help
helpPage.commandsDesc: Running without parameters will enter interactive CLI; adding --ui will start local UI.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Run inside a repository, or use `wtree --repo /path/to/repo` to specify path.
faq.a2: Use `wtree --ui --port 0` to let system auto-assign a port.
faq.a3: Force Delete is supported in both CLI and UI modes, but please note that uncommitted changes will be lost.
